title: Narrowing the Guard
goal: Learn how `Ref::map` and `RefMut::map` project borrow guards into nested struct fields.

sections.text: A `RefCell` borrow guard locks the entire wrapped structure. If another part of your program needs a different field, holding the outer guard prevents access.

sections.caption: A struct wrapped inside a RefCell.

sections.text: `Ref::map` takes an existing `Ref<T>` and a closure picking a field. It consumes the outer guard and yields a `Ref<U>` tied only to that field.

sections.caption: Ref::map narrows the Ref guard to just the name slice.

sections.text: `RefMut::map` operates identically for exclusive borrows. The wrapped `RefCell` remains borrowed dynamically until the mapped guard goes out of scope.

explanation: Learn how `Ref::map` and `RefMut::map` project borrow guards into nested struct fields.
